messages:
Devin: Heads-up  new enterprise ask. Customer profile: sustained chat ~500 qps (short convos ~20-30 tokens) + intermittent embedding blasts ~320 r/s for 20-60m windows. They want a reserved-GPU commit with explicit burst guardrails. Need ops + pricing guidance.
Sasha: Noted. Chat low-token, heavy concurrency. Do we have strict tail target?
Devin: Yes  p95 chat <= 260ms. Embeddings can be 2-3s. Also they flagged BYOK + 90d logs in questionnaire.
Kevin: Quick back-of-envelope: warmed A100-equivalent ~45 qps/GPU for this mix -> baseline GPUs = ceil(500/45)=12. Recommend reserve 14 for AZ redundancy + embedding headroom. Autoscale cap to 22 for bursts.
Kevin: Quantized option (INT8) ~1.6x throughput -> baseline ~8 GPUs but call out quality delta and require eval pass. H100 option improves per-GPU throughput ~25% -> baseline ~10 GPUs; pricing higher.
Oliver: For burst billing: propose burst credits + soft-throttle. Example: credits_per_gpu_per_day = 1200s (20min), alert at 80% usage, throttle_after_credits=true, fallback_model=chat-small-quantized. Keeps costs bounded.
Sasha: Offer three quote lanes: Safe (14 A100 reserved, autoscale 22, 12mo, standard discount), Lean (8 reserved with quantized, autoscale 16, 12mo, higher discount + quality clause), Premium (10 H100 reserved, autoscale 18, 12mo, premium pricing).
Maria: Security ops: BYOK via AWS KMS supported, but cross-region key replication needs explicit plan. 90d logs: OK, but retention add-on required for long-term storage. I'll draft questionnaire answers.
Kevin: Preheat plan (short): staged KV warm + embedding kernels. Steps: 1) canary 10% for 30m, 2) 50% for 1h, 3) full ramp. Use synthetic load to populate KV and run batch embedding jobs between stages. Example preheat loop: for i in $(seq 1 3600); do curl -s -X POST $ENDPOINT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"warm","max_tokens":8}'; sleep 1; done
deploy-bot: preheat-smoke: canary p95=245ms, p99=520ms, canary healthy :white_check_mark:
Devin: Sales asked for formula to map qps->GPUs to include in proposal. Kevin?
Kevin: Use effective_qps_per_gpu = baseline_qps * (1 + batching_gain) * kv_warm_factor. For quoting use conservative 45 qps/GPU for A100-warm, 72 qps/GPU for H100-warm, and 72 qps/GPU * 1.6 for INT8 estimated. We'll include a short calc table in the quote.
Sasha: Action items: 1) @kevin produce numeric SKU quotes for A100/H100/quantized with sample monthly spend, burst credit rules, and preheat runbook by EOD. 2) @maria draft BYOK + logs answers. 3) @devin request hourly spike traces and KMS provider from customer.
Devin: I'll request traces and confirm KMS type. We'll reconvene after the SKU numbers are in.
